posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
A plugin is not what you need. A plugin is a tool to make a mechanic. You, as the game dev, design the mechanic, not the plugin.
What do you need? An energy and hunger system? That's usually just a bunch of Variables that count down slowly within a common event that runs in parallel. You want to have a hotbar to quickly access tools? Look for "RPG Maker hotbar plugin". You want on-map battles against zombies? Look for "RPG Maker ABS plugin". That's how RPG Maker works.
